title: Implement and verify the feature-gated direct-KVM subset
commit_subject: feat(vmm): add feature-gated direct KVM subset

cargo_test_no_default_features.note: Deterministic lane: contract validation, probe validation, exit dispatch, serial capture, guest code/page-table layout, feature gate. No /dev/kvm required.

real_boot_outcome.interpretation: byte 75 == 0x4B == 'K': the marker guest booted in 64-bit long mode on real KVM, wrote the marker to I/O port 0x3F8, and halted.

missing_device_outcome.interpretation: A missing /dev/kvm produces a structured Blocked outcome, never Completed and never a fallback (deterministic; independent of host KVM).

acceptance_criteria.capability_probe_requires_api_version_12: probe::validate_api_version accepts only 12 (KVM_API_VERSION); any other value (0,11,13,-1,i32::MAX) yields ProbeError::BadApiVersion -> BlockedReason::BadApiVersion. open_and_probe calls Kvm::get_api_version() and check_extension(Cap::UserMemory). Verified on host: api_version=12, user_memory=true.
acceptance_criteria.direct_subset_boots_documented_guest_and: runner::run_subset_boot() boots the pinned marker guest (mov eax,0x4B; mov edx,0x3F8; out dx,al; hlt) in 64-bit long mode (identity page tables + GDT + CR0/CR3/CR4/EFER via KVM_SET_SREGS/KVM_SET_REGS) and the privileged test observed serial bytes [75] then stop=hlt on a capable nested-KVM x86_64 host.
acceptance_criteria.missing_dev_kvm_produces_blocked_not_pas: A nonexistent device path returns RunOutcome::Blocked{reason:kvm_unavailable}; the outcome enum has no fallback variant (compile-time const _: () = assert!(!RunOutcome::HAS_FALLBACK)) and RunOutcome::HAS_FALLBACK==false. probe_blocked_outcome maps any failed probe to Blocked. No Firecracker/QEMU/TCG fallback exists anywhere in the crate.
acceptance_criteria.default_build_does_not_link_or_launch_di: direct-kvm feature is off by default; kvm-ioctls/kvm-bindings/libc are optional deps activated only by direct-kvm. `cargo tree -p microvm-backend-directkvm` (default) contains none of them; with --features direct-kvm they appear. No other workspace crate depends on or wires this backend (grep across crates/* confirms zero references), so it is never the default backend.
acceptance_criteria.vcpu_operations_remain_on_creating_threa: VmRunner captures thread::current().id() at construction and run() asserts the caller is that thread; GuestMemory holds a raw mmap pointer making VmRunner !Send/!Sync, so the type system also prevents moving the runner (and its vCPU) to another thread. The vCPU is created and KVM_RUN-driven entirely within run() on the constructing thread; no thread is spawned.
acceptance_criteria.tcg_never_reported_as_kvm_evidence: The crate performs only real KVM ioctls behind direct-kvm; it contains no QEMU/TCG path and no fallback. A blocked or failed boot is never Converted into Completed.

key_types.KvmProbe: probe.rs: pure validate_api_version (==12) + validate_capabilities (user_memory) + ProbeError->BlockedReason mapping + probe_blocked_outcome classifier (all deterministic, no /dev/kvm). Behind direct-kvm: open_and_probe(device) opens /dev/kvm exactly once via Kvm::new_with_path, checks get_api_version()==12 and Cap::UserMemory, returns (Kvm, ProbeReport).
key_types.VmRunner: runner.rs (direct-kvm): owns Kvm + VmFd + GuestMemory (16 MiB mmap MAP_ANONYMOUS|MAP_PRIVATE) + ProbeReport + creating_thread + stop flag. new() probes, KVM_CREATE_VM, lays out the guest, registers one identity-mapped slot (KVM_SET_USER_MEMORY_REGION, slot 0, 16 MiB at GPA 0). run() asserts thread identity, KVM_CREATE_VCPU(0), KVM_SET_CPUID2 (supported CPUID), programs long mode (KVM_SET_SREGS/KVM_SET_REGS), runs the bounded KVM_RUN loop, and Drop deregisters the slot (memory_size=0) before munmap.
key_types.ExitDispatcher: dispatch.rs: pure state machine over backend-neutral GuestExit {IoOut,Hlt,FailEntry,InternalError,Unexpected}. dispatch() returns DispatchAction {Continue, Stop(StopReason), Fail(FailureReason, detail)}; records serial bytes for port 0x3F8; honors a host-stop flag between iterations. The privileged runner maps kvm_ioctls::VcpuExit -> GuestExit (owned, borrow released before reading kvm_run for suberror/raw reason).
key_types.SerialOutput: serial.rs: append-only capture of bytes written to I/O port 0x3F8; record(port,byte) ignores non-serial ports; contains_marker() checks for 0x4B. Pure and Serialize/Deserialize.
key_types.RunOutcome: outcome.rs: Completed{serial,stop} | Blocked{reason,detail} | Failed{reason,detail,serial}. No fallback variant; HAS_FALLBACK==false enforced at compile time. BlockedReason {KvmUnavailable,BadApiVersion,MissingCapability} with stable snake_case tokens for evidence.
key_types.guest: guest.rs (public module): pure guest_code() (the 12-byte marker program) and write_boot_layout() (identity page tables with 2 MiB pages, GDT with a 64-bit code segment, code at GPA 0) plus the long-mode boot constants (CR0/CR3/CR4/EFER bits, GDT descriptors, GPAs). Deterministic and unit-tested without KVM.

deterministic_tests: probe validation: api_version 12 accepted; 0/11/13/-1/MAX rejected -> BadApiVersion
probe error -> blocked classification (DeviceMissing->kvm_unavailable, BadApiVersion, MissingCapability)
exit dispatch: serial-write-then-HLT completes with marker; FailEntry/InternalError/Unexpected fail with reasons; host-stop honored between iterations; non-serial port ignored
serial output: records only port 0x3F8; captures marker in order; round-trips
guest code bytes are exactly B8 4B 00 00 00 BA F8 03 00 00 EE F4; boot layout writes code/page-tables/GDT; long-mode control bits consistent; code descriptor has L=1,D/B=0
feature gate: off by default (no-feature lane) / on when enabled (feature lane)
outcome: blocked is not completed, has no fallback, serializes with stable tag+reason
privileged_tests: direct_kvm_subset_boot_observes_serial_marker_or_blocks: real boot -> Completed{serial:[75],stop:hlt} on capable host; Blocked (not pass) when KVM absent
missing_device_is_blocked_not_pass_and_has_no_fallback: nonexistent path -> Blocked{kvm_unavailable}, never Completed/Failed, no fallback
probe_real_device_api_version_is_12_or_blocked: real probe -> api_version 12 + user_memory; blocked with structured evidence when absent
exclusions_honored: not the default backend (feature off by default; no crate wires it)
no TCG/QEMU/Firecracker fallback; TCG never reported as KVM evidence
no network/block/vsock devices, no multi-vCPU, no migration (pinned subset unchanged)
